sections.title: Overview
paragraphs: Supplier invoices, their lines and payments.
Owned by Accounts Payable. No other service writes to it; they ask its owner through /api/v1 or read posted events.

Every table carries created_at / created_by / updated_at / updated_by / version_no; audit triggers copy each change into audit_compliance.audit_event, and version triggers increment version_no for optimistic locking.

rows: A supplier invoice with match, approval and balance.
Lines with item / PO line or expense account, amount and tax.
Payments from a bank account, scheduled or executed.

sections.intro: Primary keys, foreign keys and identifying columns. Tables from other schemas are shown as schema__table.

sections.title: Guard triggers
rows: Only a DRAFT supplier invoice can be deleted - void it instead
A new supplier invoice must be DRAFT
Supplier invoices can only be entered for an ACTIVE supplier
The purchase order must be of this supplier and SENT, PART_RECEIVED or RECEIVED
A supplier invoice can only be changed while it is DRAFT
Supplier invoices move DRAFT -> APPROVED -> POSTED -> PART_PAID -> PAID (VOID before posting)
The invoice lines (amount + tax) must add up to the gross amount
Invoice lines can only be removed while the invoice is DRAFT
Lines can only be added to a DRAFT supplier invoice
The line account must be an active posting account of the invoice entity
The order line belongs to another purchase order
Invoice lines can only be changed while the invoice is DRAFT
Payments are never deleted - reverse them
A new payment is PENDING or EXECUTED
Only a POSTED or PART_PAID supplier invoice can be paid
Payments go out of an ACTIVE bank account
Payments would exceed the invoice gross amount
Invoice, amount, reference and bank account of a payment are fixed
The payment date is fixed once executed
sections.intro: Business rules the database enforces on its own.
